caption: The drawing features three main objects on a plain, light beige background. On the left side, there is a large square cloth with floral and vegetal patterns intricately illustrated along its border; these patterns consist of flowers, vines, leaves, and some paisley-like shapes, all rendered in fine brown ink lines. In the upper right section, there is a depiction of a sleeveless, loose dress or pinafore with a halter neckline; this garment has a similar brown outline and is mostly plain except for a matching embroidered pattern running along the bottom edge. Below this garment and to the right, there is a smaller isolated flourish of the same floral and leaf pattern, highlighting the design detail. All the patterns and the garment outlines are drawn in brown ink, and the objects themselves are lightly shaded with beige watercolor wash. Near the lower right edge, the name “Lillian Causey” is written in small capital letters.
title: Apron
